address: Okada Manila, New Seaside Drive, Entertainment City, Parañaque - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: Located in Okada Manila, this authentic sushi bar features an intimate 10‑seat counter, at which guests can enjoy expertly crafted maki, sashimi and nigiri. The Japanese chef sources premium Japanese seafood, selecting each ingredient with care to ensure maximum impact in every bite. His disciplined technique – thick‑cut fish paired with precisely vinegared rice – honours the fundamentals, to deliver a refined and authentic experience.
